audit_summary: The 14 operator candidates are almost all failures of INFERENCE PROCEDURE (law search, statistics, certificates), not of MECHANISMS; the archive (incl. Atlas F1-F12, Tityos T01-T18) has no mechanism-level taxonomy. Tier P: E01+E02+E07+E09 merged (circularity), E03+E04 merged (family identity), E12 narrowed to WEAK (class-level claim refuted 1/30), E13/E14 predictor-level; 3 replacements (P11 start state, P12 unqualified instrument, P13 liveness != progress) -> 13 entries, applied as JUDGE constraints. Tier M: 7 mechanism-level classes with executable witnesses/rules (ns01/signature.classify) -> the CANDIDATE exclusions, plus the 16-witness library for KNOWN_EQUIVALENCE (TAU .05). 14 was not reached by inventing distinctions.
